Text: "This town is going to need a LOT of stone, Architect. The Plains are full of it: bring home 5 and keep it in the Bank, you'll want it." Take the road out of town to the Plains. No monsters out there yet: you're the Architect, so you'll explore it yourself. Look for Shiny Rocks.

"An Inn with no ale is just a house! Hops grow wild in the Plains, but the old farmers locked them away in chests." Find small keys on the Plains and open the chests. Bring 3 Hops to the Inn (you hand them over).

"Slimes are taking over the Plains road, and travellers won't come near us! Thin them out, and bring me back 5 Green Ooze while you're at it." Green Slimes drop Green Ooze. Like everything you find, it's only yours once you get home.
Rewards: Pack Small 2; Room Plains: Blue Slime Patch; Room Plains: Blue Slime Ambush

Text: "Remember that Alchemist blueprint? Build the workshop and the Alchemist will brew you a Health Flask from that Ooze." Flasks refill at the start of every run. Blue Slimes now live in the Plains too.
Rewards: Blueprint Shop; Blueprint Tailor; Room Plains: Bunny Burrow; Room Plains: Bunny Ambush; Pack Small 2

Text: "Something BIG is growing in the Plains. I've marked its nest on your map." The Big Slime Nest is now in the Plains room deck for good. Beat it, then Go Deeper at its campfire to reach Tier 2.
"I like to carry a bit of everything. Well, a LOT of everything. Open some Plains Booster Packs and I'll show you a new way to fight." Packs come from quests, chests and the Shop.
"The roads won't be safe until the monsters are thinned out. Defeat 10 of them, any kind, and I'll make it worth your while."
"Good work! There are plenty more out there. Defeat 20 more."
"The travellers are talking about you! One last push: defeat 30 more."

"You keep losing good loot when you fall. My cousin the Tailor could sew you a Save Sack, but she needs soft Animal Hair. Bunny Warriors have moved into the Plains, and they shed like crazy." Bring home 5 Animal Hair and build the Tailor. (Word is someone has been heard shouting from a chest out on the Plains...)
Rewards: Pack Small 1; Room Plains: Trapped Chest

Text: "So YOU are the one thinning out the monsters around here. I've been watching. Impressive... for a beginner." He taps his staff. "Show me what you've learned. Beat me in a duel, and I'll teach you the deeper arts." Click the Old Master in town to fight him. Losing costs you nothing: try as often as you like.
Rewards: Pack Large 1; Blueprint Dojo; Unlock Talents; Legacy Point 1
